is_anopheles.evidence: The study analyzes Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions Vgsc (AGAP004707) and discusses L995F and L995S mutations (page 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper uses pre-existing data from the Ag1000G project (page 2). It does not report new, extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) for specific populations in the text or tables; it performs a bioinformatic analysis of existing genomic data.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses 765 specimens collected from 8 African countries (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study using t-SNE to analyze population structure.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study mentions 15 locations in 8 African countries (page 11).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states: 'Using data from the Ag1000G Project (phase 1 AR3 data release; https://www.malariagen.net/projects/ag1000) carried out by the Malaria Genomic Epidemiology Network (MalariaGEN) [22]'

supplement.evidence: The paper is a re-analysis of existing data, and the required genotype counts are not provided in the paper or its supplements.

assessment.summary: This study uses t-SNE to visualize population structure in 765 Anopheles gambiae and An. coluzzii specimens from the Ag1000G project. It is a bioinformatic re-analysis of existing genomic data and does not report primary genotype counts for specific field populations.
